normal.text: i need a nice relaxing stream so i'm gonna drive to the haunted woods and test my mortality against the arcane punishments of mankind's hubris. and eat expired MREs

normal.name: Ren
normal.text: Was finally able to play stardew valley without problems. Blue light glasses? New monitors? Who knows. Anyway, back to fishing.

normal.name: Daisybell💖🐮🧸
normal.text: Does anyone else make an intense routine out of their comfort games? I'm realizing that the way I play Tomodachi Life is like I'm a computer program. But it's such a relaxing and stabilizing part of my day. Even the way I feed the residents is full of if/then statements. No randomization.

normal.text: Hahahahahahaha 😂 a chilly day is the perfect day for some chilli 🙂‍↕️ it's 0C/32F right now and I can't wait to get home later so I can be warm 🤣 and ohhh nice! I love survival craft games like Palworld/no man's sky and such, but I like cozy games too! Been looking at loftia lately haha 😂

normal.name: Nick Martin
normal.text: Lightspeed Frontier asks the important questions, such as "what if you had Stardew Valley, but in a big mech robot?"

normal.name: 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝘼𝙣𝙜𝙧𝙮 𝙂𝙤𝙤𝙨𝙚 𓅯
normal.text: I like games like Stardew, mistria, and used to play animal crossing and such so it seems like a good relax time game. And survival crafts can be stressful but I don't mind playing on easier settings to make it more chill either. If you play PC I could give my discord and play something sometime!

normal.name: Mariah McCourt
normal.text: What your favorite Stardew Valley season songs? Mine is the Winter theme, it's like a trancey synth, slightly melancholy. My kiddo hums it all the time as stimming.

normal.name: Markus
normal.text: Solo journaling prompt for Dec 3: a flour-stained recipe for a baker's grandmother, who died in spring. "...and then, the part I never told you, add a spoonful of" – Do you deliver it as it is, or find the missing line first? Days 1-3 free (ad: my advent game) #solojournalinggame #ttrpg
normal.media: link card: Letters to Winterfall – free sampler (Dec 1-3)

normal.name: Voltaireon - 5 caustic French philosophers in a trenchcoat
normal.text: I mean, for me it's dependent on context. Stardew Valley obv I don't give a damn about the pixelation (though I'll note that the graphics aren't pure pixel, there are other visual flourishes), but if I'm playing, say, MS Flight Sim? Yeah, I want those shinies for immersion and experience.

normal.name: a full-on monet
normal.text: George has decided that instead of pie this year he is going to make the Pink Cake from the Stardew Valley cookbook. He went to three stores looking for duck eggs. I don't know how he's gonna make those little hearts. I will report back.
normal.media: image: a drawing of a pink cake with piped pink icing around the top and bottom and small pink candy hearts on the top

normal.name: Artisan Dragon
normal.text: You know what worries me about GTA6 now existing? Is that every other AAA game is going to see: Oh! Gamers love having life-sim elements in their games, let's add that. And now Ubisoft games are going to make me "workout" just so I can lug a rocket launcher to destroy the next outpost. >_>

normal.name: Christine M. Moeller, PhD
normal.text: The more I think about it, I am playing that game similarly to Stardew Valley. I'm cooking, collecting bugs in the forest, fishing, and of course petting all the cats! Who needs a main quest?😂
